identity.lineage: Asked for on 8 Nov 2026, when the owner named the two re-lays of "The shortlist redrawn for closing weeks apart" ("Clockface, Short Working"; this is layout B there): Short Run given what Balanced V8 was given for Balanced V10, its duties and rest days kept and its weeks chosen again so that no two closing weeks sit side by side and 19 weeks of 21 work one shift time, the most its weeks allow, with 32 cells moved on 11 lines (4, 5, 8, 9, 12, 14, 18, 22, 24, 25 and 26). Against Short Run: never two closing weeks together (Short Run has weeks 24, 25 and 26 in a row), at most 6 closing duties in any 14 days and 8 in any 21 (9 and 11), 19 weeks of 21 on one shift time (18), and at most 51h 10m in seven days, or up to 56h 10m if a cover week falls badly (51h 40m and 56h 50m). It pays with a week-to-week change of start of 1h 27m (1h 14m) and 12 backward and 12 forward start-time steps (11 and 11). Everything else is Short Run's: the leave, the single rest days, the weekends, the runs, the shortest rest, the heaviest and lightest weeks, the new shift times, the fit to the trains and the fatigue warnings, on the same checks
